explanation: Punctuality is taken seriously in Dutch business culture and is viewed as a basic sign of respect and reliability. Meetings are structured and expected to start and end on time, so arriving late — even by a few minutes — can genuinely damage your credibility with Dutch colleagues or clients.
local_tip: Aim to arrive a few minutes early, and message ahead immediately if you expect even a slight delay.

also_check.note: Extreme punctuality is expected in business; even a few minutes' lateness is a serious breach of etiquette.
Lateness of up to 15-30 minutes is often tolerated in business settings, though this varies by region and company.
Business meetings may start a little later than scheduled, and brief delays are tolerated more than in the Netherlands.

sources.title: Are there any cultural do's and don'ts in the Netherlands?
